answer: The karst counter is kept in thread and wander shows each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 82 aliases cost 42 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
